description: This file defines a template class 'Archetype' and related utilities for generating minimal conforming types based on 'Conformance Profiles'. It includes base classes for special member functions with properties like noexcept, deleted, or trivial, and provides mechanisms for creating archetypes with specific behaviors for testing template support and type traits.

classes.name: Archetype
classes.description: A template class representing a minimal conforming type based on a Conformance Profile, supporting various special member functions and comparison operators for testing type traits.

classes.name: PropertiesOfArchetype
classes.description: A traits struct to obtain properties of an Archetype based on its profile.

classes.name: IsArchetype
classes.description: A type trait to check if a type is an Archetype.

classes.name: NothrowBool
classes.description: A bool-like type used as a return type for noexcept comparison operators.

classes.name: ExceptionalBool
classes.description: A bool-like type used as a return type for comparison operators that may throw.

methods.name: MakeArchetype
methods.description: Creates an Archetype instance with a given internal state.
